body.message:
Thank you for reaching out to us.

We completely understand your desire for privacy in the evening. However, the apartment was professionally designed and furnished as a complete concept, which includes the current sheer curtains. Because of this set design, we are unfortunately unable to add or swap out the window treatments for blackout or privacy curtains.

We truly apologize for any discomfort or inconvenience this causes during your stay. Thank you for your understanding
